name: pkgproof
description: Verify an npm package before you install it: advisories, install scripts, typosquats, provenance.
long_description:
One tool, `verify_package`. It runs eight checks against pkgproof.net covering advisories, install scripts, typosquat and combosquat names, scope, repository provenance and maintainer reputation, and answers `safe`, `caution`, `block` or `does_not_exist` with every reason labelled as fact or heuristic against its source.

The first verification each day is free and needs no configuration. Later calls the same day cost $0.05 in USDC, paid per call over x402, and only if you configure a wallet.

algorand_private_key.title: Algorand private key
algorand_private_key.description: Base64 account key of a throwaway Algorand wallet holding USDC (ASA 31566704) on Mainnet. Not a 25-word mnemonic. Optional: the first verification each day is free without any key. Payments prefer this rail.

base_private_key.title: Base private key
base_private_key.description: 0x-prefixed private key of a throwaway EVM wallet holding USDC on Base. Optional, and only used when no Algorand key is set. Needs no ETH: the facilitator pays the gas.
